definitions.gloss: reluctant, unwilling, against one's wishes, regrettable
definitions.explanation: Not what one truly wants or intends. Describes a situation or outcome that goes against one's desires or expectations.

examples.japanese: {不本意|ふほんい}な⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧だった。
examples.english: It was a result I didn't want.

examples.japanese: {不本意|ふほんい}⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{受|う}けた→引き受ける：03140_hikiukeru⟧。
{不本意|ふほんい}な⟦{異動|いどう}→異動：01818_idou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{地方|ちほう}→地方：02369_chihou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{転勤|てんきん}→転勤：04555_tenkin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ことになった。
examples.english: Due to an unwanted transfer, I ended up being relocated to a rural area.

notes:
{不本意|ふほんい} expresses that something goes against one's true wishes or intentions. It conveys disappointment or reluctance about an outcome one cannot control.

FORMS:
{不|ふ} (not) + ⟦{本意|ほんい}→本意：22651_honi⟧ (true intention, real wish)
- Na-adjective: {不本意|ふほんい}な⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧ (an unwanted result)
- Adverbial: {不本意|ふほんい}⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧ (reluctantly, regrettably)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {不本意|ふほんい}な⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧ (unwanted result)
- {不本意|ふほんい}⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧ (reluctantly — very common in formal speech)
- {不本意|ふほんい}な⟦{引退|いんたい}→引退：01848_intai⟧ (reluctant retirement)
- {不本意|ふほんい}な⟦{異動|いどう}→異動：01818_idou⟧ (unwanted personnel transfer)

REGISTER:
Somewhat formal. Often used in public statements, apologies, or when explaining a decision made under constraints.
